(2) @/types/session Artifact — NOT shallow: it is the core data contract driving every branch (prArtifact, previewArtifact, mediaCount, previewStatus 'outdated'); lifting it requires redesigning the prop interface (e.g. pass computed previewUrl/prUrl/mediaCount/isPreviewOutdated), not a thin lift, and it transitively pulls @open-inspect/shared. (3) handleCopyLink hardcodes orto's route: `${window.location.origin}/session/${sessionId}` — an embedded app route, not generic. (4) Direct sibling dependency @/components/archive-session-dialog (outside components/ui/) carries orto-specific archive copy. Three lifts, two of which touch the core interface, plus an app-specific sibling component → keep is the defensible verdict over genericize. The ui/* primitives it uses (button, dropdown-menu, icons, alert-dialog) and cn from @/lib/utils are clean move candidates on their own; alert-dialog's closure resolves to @radix-ui/react-alert-dialog + buttonVariants from button + cn. A co-located action-bar.test.tsx exists.

referenceComponents.whatItDoes: Renders a single collapsible tool-call row: chevron + tool icon + 'ToolName summary' line + timestamp; when expanded shows Arguments / Patch / Output panes. Special-cases apply_patch (splits patchText out of args) and delegates slack-notify to a separate component. Local ToolIcon maps formatter icon-name strings (file/pencil/terminal/etc.) to icon components.
referenceComponents.appCoupling: Props are `event: Extract<SandboxEvent, { type: "tool_call" }>` (orto event union). Calls `formatToolCall(event)` from tool-formatters, `formatSessionEventTime` from @/lib/time, imports orto `@/components/ui/icons`, and branches on `event.tool === "slack-notify"`. Expanded/collapsed state is owned by the parent (isExpanded/onToggle).

referenceComponents.whatItDoes: Groups consecutive same-tool calls under one collapsible header ('Bash · 3 commands'). Single-call groups render the bare ToolCallItem with no wrapper. Owns expand state for the group and a Set of expanded child item ids. memo'd with a custom event-identity comparator. Local ToolIcon maps human tool names (Read/Edit/Bash) to icons.
referenceComponents.appCoupling: Props are `events: Array<Extract<SandboxEvent, { type: "tool_call" }>>` plus groupId. Calls `formatToolGroup(events)` from tool-formatters and `formatSessionEventTime`; renders orto ToolCallItem and orto icons. The grouping/identity logic is generic but the data shape is orto's event union.

referenceComponents.whatItDoes: A single button that cycles through the allowed reasoning-effort values for the currently selected model (low/medium/high/...), displaying the current value and calling onSelect with the next on click. Returns null if the model has no reasoning config. This is an INPUT control, not a thinking-token display.
referenceComponents.appCoupling: Imports `MODEL_REASONING_CONFIG`, `ValidModel`, `ReasoningEffort` from @open-inspect/shared and looks up the efforts list + default by model id. The cycle/label/disabled UI is fully generic once the efforts array, current value, and onSelect are passed as plain props.

referenceComponents.whatItDoes: Renders a markdown string with react-markdown + remark-gfm, hardened by a strict rehype-sanitize allowlist (tagNames/attributes/protocols, http(s)-only links) and rehype-highlight for code. Provides custom renderers for a/pre/code/p/ul/ol/blockquote/table/th/td and wraps output in Tailwind `prose` classes. Inline vs block code styling differ.
referenceComponents.appCoupling: Essentially decoupled already: props are `{ content: string; className?: string }`. Only coupling is Tailwind theme class names (prose/text-accent/border/muted) and the @tailwindcss/typography plugin. No orto session/event types. Nearly a direct lift into a generic Response component.

referenceComponents.whatItDoes: Full-height panel embedding a remote terminal in a sandboxed iframe, with a toolbar (terminal icon + 'Terminal' label, open-in-new-tab link, close button), loading state ('Connecting...'), and error state ('session expired'). Uses iframe sandbox/allow attributes for clipboard.
referenceComponents.appCoupling: Props `{ url, token, onClose }`; builds the iframe src via `buildAuthenticatedUrl(url, token)` from @/lib/urls (token-injection is orto-specific). The toolbar/loading/error shell and sandboxed-iframe pattern are generic; the auth-url construction must move out to the caller.

referenceComponents.whatItDoes: Thumbnail card for a screenshot or video artifact: 16/10 aspect preview with lazy-loaded img or muted video (with play-triangle overlay), loading/error fallbacks, and a caption + optional sourceUrl footer. Clicking the card calls onOpen. Has a compact variant.
referenceComponents.appCoupling: Props include `sessionId`, `artifactId`, `artifactType?: Artifact["type"]`, `metadata?: Artifact["metadata"]`, `onOpen(artifactId)`. Derives the media URL via `buildSessionMediaUrl(sessionId, artifactId)` and uses orto `Artifact` types and `cn`. Generic core is: a src string + caption + type + onOpen; URL construction is orto glue.

referenceComponents.whatItDoes: Modal lightbox (built on the Dialog primitive) showing a full-size screenshot or video with controls, a title/description from artifact metadata, loading/error states, and max-viewport sizing. Resets loaded/error state when the media or open state changes.
referenceComponents.appCoupling: Props `{ sessionId, artifact: Artifact | null, open, onOpenChange }`; builds the media URL via `buildSessionMediaUrl` and reads orto `Artifact.type`/`metadata`. Built on orto's @/components/ui/dialog. Generic core is: src + media type + open/onOpenChange; artifact shape and URL builder are orto glue.

referenceComponents.whatItDoes: Pure formatting layer that turns a tool_call event into display metadata: `formatToolCall` returns `{ toolName, summary, icon, getDetails() }` with per-tool summaries (Read→basename + line count, Bash→truncated command, Grep→pattern + match count, apply_patch→add/update/delete tallies, etc.); `formatToolGroup` returns a per-tool count summary. Helpers: basename, truncate, countLines, patch summary.
referenceComponents.appCoupling: Operates entirely on `Extract<SandboxEvent, { type: "tool_call" }>` and hardcodes OpenCode/Claude-Code tool names (read/edit/bash/grep/glob/task/webfetch/todowrite/apply_patch) and their camelCase arg keys. This is the decoupling fault line: it must stay APP-SIDE glue and must NOT be ported into any Tier-2 primitive — the generic Tool takes already-formatted name/summary/icon/input/output via props or a render-prop.

proposedTier2.name: Conversation
proposedTier2.purpose: Scrollable message container that auto-sticks to the bottom as new content streams in, with a 'scroll to bottom' affordance when the user has scrolled up. The outer shell for any chat/agent transcript.
proposedTier2.props: `children`; `className`. Sub-parts: ConversationContent (inner padded column), ConversationScrollButton (appears when not pinned to bottom; onClick scrolls to end). Stick-to-bottom implemented manually with a ref + scroll listener (or Radix ScrollArea viewport) — exposes no protocol-specific props.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: new (informed by the session-page transcript scroll region; orto has no extracted component)

proposedTier2.name: Message
proposedTier2.purpose: A single chat turn: avatar + content bubble + optional header (author name) and footer (timestamp, actions). Styling keys off `from` (user vs assistant) with no assumption about the underlying event model.
proposedTier2.props: Message: `{ from: "user" | "assistant" | "system"; children; className }`. MessageContent: `{ children; variant?: "contained" | "flat" }`. MessageAvatar: `{ src?; name?; fallback? }` (plain url/initials, not an orto author object). Author name, time, and copy controls are passed as children, NOT derived from an event.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: session page user_message/token message blocks (the bubble + author + timestamp + hover-copy layout), generalized from SandboxEvent to a plain `from` prop

proposedTier2.name: Response
proposedTier2.purpose: Safe streaming markdown renderer for assistant text: react-markdown + remark-gfm + a strict rehype-sanitize allowlist + rehype-highlight, with themed prose styling and http(s)-only links opened in a new tab.
proposedTier2.props: `{ content: string; className?: string; allowedTagNames?: string[]; rehypePlugins?: PluggableList; components?: Components }`. Ships the hardened sanitize schema and custom element renderers by default; callers may override `components`/plugins. No orto types — `content` is a plain string, exactly as safe-markdown already is.

proposedTier2.name: Reasoning
proposedTier2.purpose: Collapsible display of an agent's thinking/reasoning tokens (the AI Elements 'Reasoning' family — a DISPLAY surface, distinct from the effort-selector input). Can auto-expand while streaming and collapse when done, showing an elapsed-time hint.
proposedTier2.props: Reasoning: `{ isStreaming?: boolean; defaultOpen?: boolean; open?; onOpenChange?; duration?: number }`. ReasoningTrigger: `{ children? }` (defaults to 'Thinking…' / 'Thought for Ns'). ReasoningContent: `{ children }` — typically wraps a <Response> of the reasoning markdown. Reuses the chevron/rotate collapse pattern from tool-call-item.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: new (no orto source for thinking-token display; reuses the chevron + collapse interaction from tool-call-item.tsx). NOT derived from reasoning-effort-pills.

proposedTier2.name: Tool
proposedTier2.purpose: Generic collapsible tool-invocation card: header (name + status badge + chevron) over collapsible Input (formatted args) and Output (result or error) panes. The decoupled successor to tool-call-item, taking already-formatted plain props.
proposedTier2.props: Tool: `{ defaultOpen?; open?; onOpenChange? }`. ToolHeader: `{ name: string; state: "input-streaming" | "input-available" | "output-available" | "output-error"; summary?: string; icon?: ReactNode }` — `state` is a plain prop union, NOT an orto event field; the name→icon and the per-tool summary are supplied by the CALLER (orto keeps tool-formatters.ts app-side and passes name/summary/icon in). ToolInput: `{ input: unknown }` (pretty-prints JSON; caller may pass a custom node for special cases like patch text). ToolOutput: `{ output?: ReactNode; errorText?: string }`. No SandboxEvent, no formatToolCall.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: tool-call-item.tsx (the collapsible header + args/output panes), decoupled by replacing the SandboxEvent prop with {name, state, input, output} plain props and pushing tool-formatters logic to the caller

proposedTier2.name: ToolGroup
proposedTier2.purpose: Collapses a run of related tool invocations under one summary header ('Read · 3 files'), expanding to a vertically-ruled list of child <Tool> items. Generic version of tool-call-group with no event coupling.
proposedTier2.props: ToolGroup: `{ label: string; summary?: string; icon?: ReactNode; defaultOpen?; count?: number; children }`. Renders children (<Tool> items) inside the expanded list; when a single child is provided callers can skip the wrapper. The 'which calls group together' decision and the summary string are computed by the caller, not inside the primitive.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: tool-call-group.tsx (header + child-list + single-item passthrough), decoupled from the SandboxEvent[] prop and formatToolGroup

proposedTier2.name: Task
proposedTier2.purpose: Collapsible plan/checklist surface for agent to-do lists (AI Elements 'Task' family): a header with overall progress over a list of TaskItem rows with per-item status.
proposedTier2.props: Task: `{ title?: string; defaultOpen?; open?; onOpenChange? }`. TaskTrigger: `{ title; status?: "pending" | "in-progress" | "completed" }`. TaskItem: `{ status: "pending" | "in-progress" | "completed" | "error"; children }` (renders a status glyph + label). TaskItemFile: `{ children }` for inline file chips. All status is a plain prop union; no TodoWrite/SandboxEvent shape.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: new (orto surfaces TodoWrite only as a tool summary in tool-formatters; this is a fresh display primitive)

proposedTier2.name: CodeBlock
proposedTier2.purpose: Standalone fenced-code display with a language label and a copy-to-clipboard button that shows transient success feedback. Used by Response for blocks and available on its own.
proposedTier2.props: CodeBlock: `{ code: string; language?: string; showLineNumbers?: boolean; className? }`. CodeBlockCopyButton: `{ onCopy?; onError?; timeoutMs?: number }` (defaults to navigator.clipboard with copied-state toggle). Highlighting via rehype-highlight (consistent with Response); no orto types.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: new (consolidates the copy-with-1.5s-feedback pattern seen in the session page message blocks and the pre/code styling from safe-markdown)

proposedTier2.name: PromptInput
proposedTier2.purpose: The composer: a form wrapper around an auto-resizing textarea with a toolbar row (model selector slot, effort control, custom buttons) and a submit/stop button whose behavior follows a status prop. Generalizes the session-page footer.
proposedTier2.props: PromptInput: `{ onSubmit(text): void; className }` (form). PromptInputTextarea: `{ value; onChange; placeholder?; onSubmitShortcut? }` (Enter-to-send, Shift+Enter newline). PromptInputToolbar / PromptInputTools: layout slots for arbitrary controls. PromptInputSubmit: `{ status: "ready" | "submitted" | "streaming" | "error"; disabled?; onStop?() }` — renders Send when ready and a Stop button while streaming (modeling orto's isProcessing as a status enum, not wiring isProcessing directly). PromptInputModelSelect / PromptInputEffort: thin wrappers that accept value/options/onChange as plain props.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: session page footer composer (textarea + floating Send/Stop + model+effort footer row); PromptInputEffort is derivedFrom reasoning-effort-pills with MODEL_REASONING_CONFIG/@open-inspect/shared stripped (takes efforts: string[] + value + onSelect)

proposedTier2.name: Suggestion
proposedTier2.purpose: Horizontally scrollable row of clickable prompt suggestions / quick-start chips shown above or inside an empty composer.
proposedTier2.props: Suggestions: `{ children; className }` (scroll row). Suggestion: `{ suggestion: string; onClick?(suggestion): void; children? }` — a pill button; passing the suggestion text is the only contract.

proposedTier2.name: Actions
proposedTier2.purpose: Row of icon-button actions attached to a message (copy, retry, thumbs up/down, etc.) that reveal on hover, generalizing the hover-copy control in orto messages.
proposedTier2.props: Actions: `{ children; className }`. Action: `{ label: string; onClick?(); tooltip?: string; children: ReactNode }` — a tooltip'd icon button. Reveal-on-hover styling is opt-in via a className/group pattern; no event/copy logic baked in (caller wires clipboard).
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: session page message copy-on-hover button (group-hover opacity + title/aria pattern), generalized to arbitrary actions

proposedTier2.name: Loader
proposedTier2.purpose: Lightweight inline loading/streaming indicators: a spinner and a 'shimmer' text variant for 'Thinking…' / 'Connecting…' states.
proposedTier2.props: Loader: `{ size?: number; className? }` (spinner). Optional TextShimmer: `{ children; className }`. Pure presentational, no props tied to session state.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: new (informed by the 'Connecting…' / 'Loading…' inline states in terminal-panel and the media cards)

proposedTier2.name: Sources
proposedTier2.purpose: Collapsible 'Sources' / citations block listing external links the agent referenced (AI Elements 'Sources' family).
proposedTier2.props: Sources: `{ count?: number; defaultOpen? }` (collapsible header 'Used N sources'). Source: `{ href: string; title?: string }` — a safe external link (target=_blank rel=noopener). Plain url/title props only.

proposedTier2.name: WebPreview
proposedTier2.purpose: Generic embedded-iframe panel with a toolbar (label, open-in-new-tab, optional close), loading and error overlays, and a sandboxed iframe — for live previews, remote terminals, or any embedded web surface.
proposedTier2.props: WebPreview: `{ src: string; title?: string; sandbox?: string; allow?: string; onClose?(); loadingNode?: ReactNode; errorNode?: ReactNode }`. WebPreviewNavigation/WebPreviewBody slots for the toolbar/iframe. The caller passes a ready-to-use `src` (orto builds the token-authenticated URL via buildAuthenticatedUrl on its side) — no token/auth logic inside.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: terminal-panel.tsx (toolbar + loading/error overlay + sandboxed iframe), decoupled by replacing {url, token} + buildAuthenticatedUrl with a plain `src` prop

proposedTier2.name: Image
proposedTier2.purpose: Generic media thumbnail card for an image or video: aspect-ratio preview with lazy-load, video play overlay, loading/error fallbacks, and an optional caption/subtitle footer; clickable to open a lightbox.
proposedTier2.props: `{ src: string; type?: "image" | "video"; caption?: string; subtitle?: string; onOpen?(); compact?: boolean; className? }`. Takes a resolved media URL (orto computes it via buildSessionMediaUrl) — no Artifact type, no sessionId/artifactId.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: screenshot-artifact-card.tsx, decoupled by replacing sessionId/artifactId + Artifact metadata + buildSessionMediaUrl with a plain src/type/caption

proposedTier2.name: Lightbox
proposedTier2.purpose: Generic modal media viewer for a full-size image or video with controls, title/description, viewport sizing, and loading/error states. Pairs with Image for click-to-expand.
proposedTier2.props: `{ src: string | null; type?: "image" | "video"; title?: string; description?: string; open: boolean; onOpenChange(open): void }`. Built on a Dialog primitive; takes a resolved `src` (orto resolves the artifact URL on its side) — no Artifact, no buildSessionMediaUrl.
proposedTier2.derivedFrom: media-lightbox.tsx, decoupled by replacing {sessionId, artifact} + buildSessionMediaUrl with plain src/type/title/description props
